name: German for Studying - Informatics: Writing, Presenting and Discussing Scientific Texts
description: Bachelor students of Informatics, Business Informatics, Informatics: Games Engineering and (providing there is enough capacity) Master’s students of Informatics expand their terminology. Students analyze texts with regard to technical vocabulary and typographical conventions and develop strategies to produce different types of texts. They practice convincingly addressing scientific questions and presenting research results by writing an essay and making a presentation.
